newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Blackburn continues buying Fotex shares.
newsitem.headline: Blackburn continues buying Fotex shares.

text.p: Panama-registered Blackburn International, the biggest single shareholder in Hungarian retailer Fotex Rt, continued to buy Fotex shares on July 2, Blackburn said on Friday.
Blackburn said in the Budapest Stock Exchange's official gazette that it bought 15,000 Fotex shares on July 2, Wednesday at 212 forints per share.
Blackburn said earlier that it purchased 50,000 Fotex shares at 215 forints per share on Monday and bought 24,563 at 205 forints per share on Tuesday.

Fotex shares rallied sharply last week and earlier this week and market talk at that time said the rise might be connected to a recent conflict between two main Fotex shareholders, Fotex's General Manager Gabor Varszegi, via his Blackburn holding, and Templeton Emerging Markets.
Templeton said last month it was suing Fotex for violating minority shareholders' rights and failing to comply with Hungarian securities regulations.
But Gabor Varszegi, Fotex's founder, denied Templeton's allegations and accused the fund of attempting a hostile takeover.
